title: Lower WEIGHT_DECAY (0.2 -> 0.05)
description: Changed WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.05 (Muon cautious weight decay), all else at baseline (ASPECT_RATIO=96, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=2^18, DEPTH=8)
reflection: val_bpb 0.983085 vs baseline 0.982558 -- slightly worse, essentially a no-op/small regression, not a real improvement. Weight decay at 0.2 was apparently not over-regularizing in this short budget; lowering it doesn't help and may hurt marginally (though the gap is close to the ~0.0002 noise band seen in round 2's duplicate runs). Combined with a2's and a5's data points at other WEIGHT_DECAY values this round, should give a fuller picture of the axis -- if 0.1 and 0.0 also don't beat baseline, weight decay can be closed as a non-lever here, unlike width and batch-size which had ~1.5% each.
